student_reviews_summary.faculty: Experienced and highly qualified faculty, mostly with MPT/PhD qualifications. Strong academic and research culture.

placement_records.hospital_tie_ups: Government Medical College Hospital, Kottayam (1,200+ beds) — primary clinical training hospital.

college_name: KMCT College of Allied Health Sciences, Kozhikode
hospital_affiliation: KMCT Medical College Hospital, Kozhikode (500+ beds)

fee_structure.note: Second highest fee on this list. Management quota seats significantly higher. Verify at lbscentre.in.

admission_info: Admission via LBS CAP based on 12th PCB marks. No entrance exam required. Minimum 50% in PCB aggregate (45% for SC/ST). Some seats reserved for eligible minority students.

clinical_exposure: KMCT Medical College Hospital — 500+ beds. Kozhikode Govt Medical College accessible for supplementary training. Rich patient diversity.

student_reviews_summary.placements: Strong Gulf placement network — KMCT has deep alumni ties in UAE, Saudi Arabia, and Qatar. Management supports overseas placements actively.

student_reviews_summary.faculty: Well-structured curriculum with experienced faculty. Good student-faculty interaction.

placement_records.hospital_tie_ups: KMCT Medical College Hospital (500+ beds). Kozhikode Govt Medical College for supplementary training.
placement_records.placement_success: Strong Gulf placement network. Alumni in UAE, Saudi Arabia, and Qatar. Growing national placement record.

Modern campus with good infrastructure

Strong alumni network in Middle East
